text: Both cleaned extracts share one real, reliable column: SalesOrderID. Joining on it brings territory information onto every customer-extract row.
pd dot merge is pandas' real join function. It takes the two DataFrames, the shared key with on, and the join type with how, the same pattern this path's own Python course teaches.

How equals left keeps every row from customer_df, the left side, and brings in matching territory columns wherever SalesOrderID matches. A customer row with no match still survives, it just gets NaN instead of disappearing.

A small number of orders exist in the customer extract but not the territory extract. Rather than drop those rows, fillna labels them Unknown, so they still count toward segment totals while staying clearly flagged.
With one combined DataFrame ready, next lesson loads it straight into Power BI as a Power Query source.
